verdict.rationale: Bolna's own docs describe a quickstart that goes from API key to a real phone call with transcript and recording in about five minutes. They also cover agent creation through Agent Studio in 5–8 minutes, per-language prompts, voice selection, and phone-number management through built-in telephony or the CLI. Together these cover prompt, voice, number and a first live call well within an hour. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the time-to-first-call, and detailed documentation of buying or assigning a phone number in the quickstart flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: Go from an API key to a real phone call (with a transcript and recording) in four steps.
Make your first Voice AI call with the Bolna API — verify your key, get an agent, place a call, and fetch the transcript in about five minutes.
Agent Studio turns a short description of your use case into a production-grade, call-ready voice AI agent — in 5 to 8 minutes.
You can choose different voices, accents, and speaking styles to match your brand.
Add multiple languages, set a default, and write a dedicated prompt for each.
lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal
Instead of using Bolna's built-in telephony providers (Twilio, Plivo, etc.), you can use your existing SIP trunk provider, your own phone numbers, and your own calling rates.
